description: Returns Neblla's developer guide by `section` (default "core": file layout and client/server contract), in Spanish unless `lang` is "en". "tools/<name>" is one tool's full reference. Long text comes in chunks: pass `nextOffset` as `offset`. Changes nothing. More: neblla_get_llms tools/get_llms

appId.description: Only the chapters of that app's modules.

group.description: With section "access": only this group of the team.

lang.description: "en" for the English version where one exists (else Spanish, with `langNote`).

role.description: With section "access": only this role of the app.

section.description: Which part of the guide to read. Default "core". "index" = contents, "full" = everything, "access" (with appId) = what each role and group can use, "tools/<name>" = one tool's reference. Chapters: empezar (when to use neblla); core (the base contract); salas (rooms and matchmaking); servidor (server (fog and no-code)); identidad (identity and persistence); social (friends and inbox); correo (email to your users (amazon ses)); comunidad (community); pagos (purchases); catalogo (products, menus and stalls); ia (built-in ai); nube (save to your cloud (google drive, dropbox)); mundo (the 3d engine); sonido (eco and sound in your apps); creator (the creation portal and the store); publicar (publishing and quotas); referencia (sdk reference); mcp (mcp server)

name: neblla_get_llms
title: Read the developer guide
